en.ammaar-muslim: 3. [3/85] al-Kafi: Ali from his father AND Muhammad b. Ismail from al-Fadhl b. Shadhan all together from Hammad from Hariz from Zurara who said:
Abu Ja’far said عليه السلام: follow in the Wudhu the way Allāh Mighty and Majestic said – begin with the face… begin with what Allāh Mighty and Majestic began with.
